activity.notes: On 31 August 1991 the Uzbek SSR was renamed the Republic of Uzbekistan and independence was proclaimed. Karimov remained president continuously and served until his death on 2 September 2016. His nationwide presidential election on 29 December 1991 occurred within this already-continuous presidency.

sources.title: The main national holiday of Uzbekistan is the Independence Day — Government of Uzbekistan
sources.citation_text: The Government of Uzbekistan states that on 31 August 1991 the Uzbek SSR was renamed the Republic of Uzbekistan and state independence was proclaimed.

sources.title: President of the Republic of Uzbekistan Islam Abduganievich Karimov — UZA
sources.citation_text: The state news agency records Karimov's death on 2 September 2016 and his leadership of independent Uzbekistan for 25 years.
